items.description: Landlord may terminate the Lease by notice after a partial Taking that affects a part material to operation of the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: Landlord may terminate this Lease by notice to Tenant given within sixty (60) days following the date upon which Landlord received notice of such Taking.
items.trigger: If the part of the Building or the Property that is taken or condemned as part of the Taking contains a part of the Tenant Space, the Building or the Property that, in Landlord’s reasonable discretion, is material to the operation of the Tenant Space

items.anchor_event: Tenant received notice of such Taking
items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by notice if a partial Taking leaves no reasonable access or makes the Tenant Space unfit for use.
items.span_text: Tenant may terminate this Lease by notice to Landlord given within sixty (60) days following the date upon which Tenant received notice of such Taking.
items.trigger: If, by reason of a Taking of part of the Building or the Property Tenant no longer has reasonable means of access to the Tenant Space, or the Tenant Space is unfit for use by Tenant in the ordinary course of Tenant’s business

items.description: Landlord must restore the remaining Tenant Space at its own expense as soon as reasonably practicable after a Taking if the Lease is not terminated.
items.span_text: Landlord, at Landlord’s expense, shall, as soon as is reasonably practicable, restore that part of the Tenant Space that was not taken or condemned as part of the Taking
items.trigger: If this Lease shall not have been terminated pursuant to Sections 9.1.2.3 or 9.1.2.4, above

items.description: Landlord must refund prepaid Base Rent and prepaid share of property Taxes, net of amounts Tenant owes, when the Lease is terminated due to a Taking.
items.span_text: Landlord shall refund to Tenant any prepaid Base Rent and Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes – Property, less any sum then owing to Landlord by Tenant.
items.trigger: In the event that this Lease is terminated pursuant to Sections 9.1.2.1, 9.1.2.3 or 9.1.2.4, above

items.description: Base Rent is reduced proportionately to the reduction of the Premises where the Lease is not terminated after a Taking.
items.span_text: Base Rent shall be reduced proportionately to the extent that the Premises is reduced as a result of the Taking.
items.trigger: If, however, this Lease is not terminated pursuant to any of said Sections

items.description: The party first receiving a condemnation award that includes an amount for the other party must promptly account for it to the other.
items.span_text: the party first receiving the same shall promptly make an accounting of same to the other.
items.trigger: If any such award that is made, or compensation that is paid, to either party specifically includes an award or amount for the other

items.description: Tenant must procure and maintain insurance throughout the Term per Exhibit B-1 at its own expense.
items.span_text: Tenant shall, at Tenant’s expense, procure and maintain throughout the Term of this Lease a policy or policies of insurance in accordance with the terms and requirements set forth in Exhibit “B-1” to this Lease.

items.description: Tenant's insurance policies for the Tenant Space must include a waiver of subrogation consistent with Tenant's waiver of claims against the Landlord Group.
items.span_text: All of Tenant’s insurance policies with respect to the Tenant Space shall be endorsed so as to include a waiver of subrogation

items.description: Tenant's commercial general liability policies must name Landlord, its managing agent and designated Holders as additional insureds.
items.span_text: The commercial general liability policies procured by Tenant hereunder shall name Landlord and Landlord’s managing agent, and any Holders designated by Landlord as additional insureds.

items.description: Tenant must give Landlord certificates of insurance before occupying and before each policy expires.
items.span_text: Prior to occupying the Tenant Space, and prior to the expiration of each such policy, Tenant shall submit to Landlord certificates of insurance evidencing such policies (and the applicable renewals thereof) being in effect.

items.description: If Landlord obtains insurance for Tenant after a failure to provide proof, Tenant must reimburse the cost plus an administrative surcharge.
items.span_text: Tenant shall, within ten (10) days after Landlord’s demand therefor, pay to Landlord an amount equal to the cost of such insurance policies plus an administrative surcharge of ten percent (10%).
items.trigger: If Tenant does not deliver to Landlord a certificate or other proof of renewal or coverage from an insurance carrier at least ten (10) business days prior to the expiration dates of each expiring policy

items.description: Landlord must procure and maintain insurance throughout the Term per Exhibit B-2 at its own expense.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, at Landlord’s expense, procure and maintain throughout the Term of this Lease a policy or policies of insurance in accordance with the terms and requirements set forth in Exhibit “B-2” to this Lease.

items.description: Tenant may not make a Transfer without Landlord's prior written consent, which may not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.
items.span_text: Tenant shall not effect a Transfer, without Landlord’s express prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.
